summary: ansible.builtin.striptags is the Jinja builtin filter that strips SGML/XML tags and collapses adjacent whitespace.
questions: How do I remove HTML tags from a string in Ansible?

answer_card.title: striptags filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ html | striptags }}` strips SGML/XML tags and replaces adjacent whitespace with a single space (Jinja builtin).
